thread:
sam: heads-up — noticed full request bodies (including user-supplied PII) in the ingest pipeline for the /inspect/* routes during the canary run earlier today :grimacing:
 tia: oh no. which tenant? can you paste an example (sanitized) or a quick grep? :eyes:
 sam: tenant `acme-sb` — here's a redacted snippet from the raw message: `{"prompt":"<REDACTED_EMAIL> wants pricing","meta":{"route":"/inspect/session","consent":"inspect"}}`
 kevin: is that coming from the SDK or from our proxy layer?
 sam: looks like proxy forwarded full body before our redaction middleware kicked in. stacktrace points to `route-router` fast-path where we short-circuit to `inspect_mode` branch.
 marco: that branch intentionally bypasses normal scrubbing so SREs can debug, but it should never be enabled for production tenants. we must have a flag drifted on.
 liz: we rolled a small change to `inspect_mode` last week to add per-tenant toggles — maybe old tenants defaulted to true. checking console now.
 telemetry-bot: alert: stream-ingest:unredacted_body_detected count=3 tenant=acme-sb first_seen=1719000320
 tia: ok we need immediate mitigation: 1) flip the tenant-level inspect flag off for acme-sb 2) purge any persisted unredacted segments 3) add an automated guard to prevent proxy short-circuit when `X-Consent-Mode` != `inspect`
 kevin: agree. small patch idea for proxy guard: check header and env before fast-path. snippet: ```js
// proxy middleware
if (req.headers['x-consent-mode'] !== 'inspect' && process.env.NODE_ENV==='prod') {
  // never short-circuit
} else {
  // existing debug path
}
```
 marco: ^ also add server-side telemetry rule: do not emit full `body` field to kafka unless `sanitized=true`. The sink can include `body_summary` instead.
 sam: can we also add a temporary sampling rule that excludes /inspect/* from sampling that sends raw bodies to the telemetry cluster? we still want traces but not payloads.
 liz: yes — I'll add a per-route redact-profile in the console: `inspect => redact_mode: minimal_payload` for all production tenants. should be a 2-step rollout: console toggle + infra guard.
 tia: ops-bot, can you run the purge for acme-sb persisted logs created between 1719000000 and 1719001200 and rotate the consumer offsets?
 ops-bot: acknowledged. purge job queued `job-8172`. consumer offsets will be rotated after purge completes. ETA ~6m.
 telemetry-bot: note: creating regression alert to detect `unredacted_body_detected` > 0 for >1 tenant in 1h window.
 kevin: longer term: we should remove any code paths that assume inspect_mode implies bypass scrubbing. Instead, make it require an explicit ephemeral header `X-Inspect-Auth: <token>` that only dev machines have.
 sam: +1. also suggest adding a console-only audit view that shows who enabled inspect for which tenant and when.
 liz: putting an RFC in #docs: we'll propose `inspect` semantics: only devs with 2FA and audit entry can enable, and default off for new tenants.
 marco: action items: liz toggles per-route redact-profile (ASAP), ops-bot purge/sync (in progress), kevin to patch proxy guard (PR), tia to add alert and console audit entry. i'll follow up with retro notes.
 sam: thanks everyone, staying on this for next hour if anything bubbles up :thumbsup:
